main_result.title: Public summary-only nondeterminism artifacts need a fail-closed semantic adapter: raw divergence can support a raw-output instability statement, but protected score/sign must remain unknown unless explicitly measured.

public_artifact_inspection.result: Recursive repository-tree inspection and targeted code search found the committed nondeterminism summary and general campaign performance JSONL/traces, but no obvious per-run token-id arrays tied to the warmed nondeterminism process cells. The public summary carries distinct-output counts and first-divergence indices, not the complete per-run generated sequences needed by decision_stat_first_divergence_analyzer.py.
public_artifact_inspection.measurement_implication: Do not synthesize a protected score or oriented sign from those summary fields. Preserve protected-statistic status as unknown until a full output trace plus frozen deterministic scorer, or explicit scorer labels, is available.

behavior: Parses the public gfx1100 within-process summary cells as process-level descriptive clusters.
Maps distinct_outputs>1 only to an explicit raw-output any-divergence score; it does not call that a protected-statistic mismatch.
Sets protected_statistic_status and paired_oriented_sign_status to unknown for every summary cell.
Marks every emitted cluster record retrospective and prospective_certificate_eligible=false because the adapter located the evidence after outcomes and did not predeclare sequence/tolerance.
Includes process/model/depth/kernel-state fingerprint fields and lower-level generation count without treating the generations as independent certification trials.

main_result.design_rule: Evidence adapters should be monotone in semantic commitment: a source that supports only raw-output divergence must not be upgraded by the adapter into score divergence, paired sign divergence, correctness loss, or causal mechanism. Downstream verification can refine UNKNOWN to MATCH/MISMATCH only with new explicit evidence.

measurement_validity_rules: Summary-level first-divergence positions establish that generated sequences differ, not that a frozen evaluator output differs.
A retrospective cluster summary may describe process-level instability but cannot be replayed as a predeclared anytime sequence without a separate prospective protocol.
Keep raw-output, deterministic-score, paired-score and oriented-sign mismatch as distinct observables with explicit UNKNOWN states.
Repository search failure is not proof that raw traces do not exist elsewhere; record only that no obvious committed trace was found in the inspected public tree.
scope_guards: The adapter currently understands the public gfx1100 summary schema only.
It does not infer correctness, task failure, or paired sign from distinct_outputs or first-divergence indices.
It does not itself perform sequential inference on retrospective records.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read.

frontier.action: Add confidence-sequence inversion mode to cluster_mismatch_anytime_certifier.py and quantify the price of full estimation versus the current predeclared-threshold certification mode under zero and sparse nonzero cluster paths.
Search new public repeated-inference artifacts for complete per-run outputs or explicit deterministic scorer labels so UNKNOWN score propagation can be resolved without proxy inference.
Design a process/server-lifetime fingerprint lease protocol with cluster-level stability evidence, drift invalidation and no request-level pseudoreplication.
Extend protected-statistic prefix certificates to JSON/schema/tool-call scorers and distinguish syntactic validity, semantic task score and paired sign.

exact_next_action: Extend cluster_mismatch_anytime_certifier.py with a full anytime upper-bound inversion mode, then compare it against the fixed-tolerance e-test so the system can choose the weakest sufficient statistical object for each deployment decision.
